title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
content: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

title: Germany's political center fights for relevance after far-right and far-left gains
content: Centrist politicians are soul-searching after electoral gains by the far right and the far left. Today's weak coalitions, political fragmentation and dire economy echo a past that led to the rise of fascism.

title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
content: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

title: October 1 ushered in a new era in U.S. foreign aid. What's the plan? Will it work?
content: The America First strategy asks for a Memorandum of Understanding as a condition for healthcare and development aid. It's been praised for promoting self-reliance but criticized for its conditions.

title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
content: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi, Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.

title: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
content: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.

title: Cornell rape case gets special prosecutor. And, Renee Good's family sues the government
content: New legal action in two closely watched cases: one at Cornell, the other over Renee Good's death. We take a closer look.

title: Why is diesel more expensive than regular gas?
content: Diesel hasn't always been more expensive than other gasoline. Then in 2004, a switch happened due to air quality standards, demand, and taxes. In this week's Indicator newsletter, we dig into diesel prices, what kind of fun people are buying, and other forms of making your tax bill smaller.

title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
content: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
content: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.
